title: Namespace and surface binding table
description: The declaration that answers, for any edit, which single location is authoritative. It binds each top-level storage namespace to a role, and each agent-addressable surface to its canonical root, standing branch, history target, and live-binding evidence.

namespaces.description: The four namespace roles. A directory's namespace determines what it may be; matching names across namespaces are different roles, not copies to keep in sync.

roots_outside_the_taxonomy.description: Roots that belong to other chapters of the model and are never source: the immutable release store, the runtime state directory, and the artifact output root.

retired_parents.description: Explicitly registered so no alias can later be declared beneath a root that was migrated away from, and no guard hard-fails against a path that is no longer authoritative.

surfaces.description: One row per agent-addressable repository. A registry row is evidence that the surface legitimately exists; it authorizes nothing.

canonical_source_root.description: The one declared source of truth for this surface, at a time.

standing_branch.description: The branch the surface is healthy on; verified work is normalized onto it.

authoritative_history_target.description: The remote that preserves canonical history. Mirror and rollback remotes are not it.

handoff_root.description: An operator-facing copy or sync target; never the delivery mechanism and never canonical.

live_binding_ref.description: Pointer into the observed live-bindings snapshot, which records the latest binding actually seen.
